The gate's first screen: the product hero, Sign in, Use a license key, and the extras the product supports, such as a trial, restoring a purchase or activating offline. It offers only the paths the build supports, so a key-only product never shows a sign-in button.

## In each kit

<Tabs syncKey="ui-kit">
  <TabItem label="SwiftUI">
    **Drop-in.** The gate's first screen inside `.polarisKeyGate`: the 120 pt hero icon, `Welcome to <Product>`, `by <Developer>`, Sign in (Liquid Glass primary) and Use a license key (glass secondary); a one-path product says so in the lede and shows that path inline.

    **Styled part.** `WelcomeView(screen:onSignIn:onUseKey:onExtra:inline:)` and `.welcomeStyle(_:)`.

    **Headless.** `KitStates.welcome(_:)`; `PolarisKeyGateModel.welcome`.

    [SwiftUI](/docs/build/ui/frameworks/swiftui/) has the theme, the restyle hooks and the sample.

  </TabItem>
</Tabs>
